description: This PHP class 'Language' extends 'ListableDisplayField' and represents a display field for languages within the OrangeHRM reporting framework. It provides methods to specify the associated DTO class, entity aliases, and relevant fields for reporting purposes.

classes.name: Language
classes.description: Represents a language display field in the reporting system, specifying DTO class, entity alias, and fields for queries.

methods.name: getDtoClass
methods.description: Returns the class name of the Data Transfer Object (DTO) associated with this display field.

methods.name: getEntityAliases
methods.description: Returns an array of entity alias names used in queries involving this display field.

methods.name: getFields
methods.description: Specifies the database fields related to this display control, here 'employee.empNumber'.
